wholeGridBlur.method: 19x19 Gaussian blur applied to the accepted rectified grid

quadrantBlur.method: top-left quadrant replaced with the corresponding blurred pixels

referencePolicy: Compare sharpness and worst-quadrant ratio against the same sharpest frame in an eight-sample stationary window; both must retain at least 85 percent. Reset on motion and after autofocus completes.
limitations: This is synthetic blur applied at fixed detected geometry, not a live camera or physical-device benchmark.
The replay reuses original lighting and camera geometry; grid re-detection on blurred frames is not measured.
The prior policy ignored sharpness and partial-focus measurements, so all 63 otherwise eligible stable geometries would have remained shutter-ready.
Only 63 of 110 original photographs met the existing lighting, edge, size and shape guidance limits; this replay makes no claim about capture readiness for the remaining 47.
Relative measurements cannot reject uniformly blurry initial frames and permit a new lower-quality reference after the eight-sample window expires.
Autofocus, exposure metering, final JPEG crispness, capture latency and sustained-device memory/thermal behavior require physical tests.
